name: Li Dong
bio: Li Dong is a Chinese actor.

credits.title: The Bullet Vanishes
credits.overview: One rainy night in an arms factory near Shanghai, a young female worker accused of stealing a box of bullets from the ruthless Boss Ding is violently killed in a game of Russian roulette. Half a month later, a series of inexplicable deaths takes place in the factory, where the victims are shot but no bullets are found.
